frontmatter.name: architect
frontmatter.description: Architecture, hard debugging and trade-offs. Use for design decisions that span several systems, choosing between approaches, root-causing bugs whose cause is unclear (wrong behaviour, crashes, performance), and reviewing a plan or diff for risks before it is built.

frontmatter.name: Explore
frontmatter.description: Fast read-only search. Use proactively to find files, symbols, call sites and config, to read code and answer "where is X / how does Y work" before changing anything. Returns locations and short excerpts, not file dumps.

frontmatter.name: implementer
frontmatter.description: Regular coding work. Use proactively to implement a well-specified feature or fix, write or update tests, wire data into systems, and do refactors with a clear plan. Not for open-ended architecture questions or hard bugs whose cause is unknown.

frontmatter.name: mechanic
frontmatter.description: Simple mechanical edits that need no design decisions. Use proactively for renames, moving or copying a value across files, updating strings/lang entries, bumping numbers in data tables, fixing typos, adding an import, or applying the same small change in many places when the exact change is already specified.
frontmatter.tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Edit, Write, Bash

frontmatter.name: scribe
frontmatter.description: Writes prose from a short summary - READMEs, docs, notes, commit and PR bodies - in the existing style of the project. Use instead of drafting docs yourself.

frontmatter.name: shipper
frontmatter.description: Ships finished, verified work - commits, pushes the branch and opens the PR. Merges only when the main session says the user approved the merge. Use instead of doing the commit/push/PR steps yourself.

frontmatter.name: verifier
frontmatter.description: Runs a project's checks and reports only the verdict. Use proactively after any code or data change instead of running the checks yourself - returns pass/fail per check and the failures with their first error lines, never the full log.

frontmatter.name: ferrite-security
frontmatter.description: Use when reviewing a Ferrite change for security, or touching the ferrite:// scheme, the JSON API, navigation, popups, downloads, permissions, private mode, the clipboard, ad blocking or dependencies. Encodes the threat model, invariants with code references, a yes/no review checklist, tooling and abuse tests.

frontmatter.name: ferrite-cef
